lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Jimmy Hoffa was last seen in a restaurant parking lot in nineteen seventy-five. Then he was gone.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: The former Teamsters boss had gone there to meet two reputed mobsters.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: From a pay phone, he called his wife. He said he'd been stood up.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: His car was found in the lot.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Weeks later, police dogs picked up his scent in a different car.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Seven years later he was declared legally dead. There was still no body.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: In two thousand one, D N A showed a hair found in that car was his.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: In twenty thirteen, the F B I dug up a field near Detroit. Nothing.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Then a tip sent agents under a New Jersey bridge. Nothing of evidentiary value.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Fifty years on, the F B I says the case is still active.
